title: Physician-versus Large Language Model-Generated Summaries in the Emergency Department
details: NB Golchini, N Mehandru, A Alaa, M Molina - medRxiv, 2025
abstract: High–quality one–liner summaries are essential in the emergency department (ED) to support rapid decision–making, but generating them is cognitively demanding and adds to documentation burden; large language models (LLMs) may help by …
